messages.author: Shiji Zhao
messages.body:
Hi Amber users,
This is a quick announcement of the availability of the tutorial for the
PyRESP program. (
http://htmlpreview.github.io/?https://github.com/ShijiZ/PyRESP/blob/master/tutorial/pyresp.html
)
I have been contacted by several Amber users and developers who are
interested in using PyRESP that a tutorial will be appreciated. This
tutorial is located on the github repository for PyRESP, and it will be
available on Amber tutorials page (
http://ambermd.org/tutorials/
) soon.
Thank you again for your interest in the PyRESP program!
Shiji Zhao
